panels.title: 1. Reduce sustained overtime
lines: Attrition 30.5% with overtime vs 10.4% without; holds after controlling for role, tenure and pay.
Action: monthly overtime reviews, rebalance workload. Start with Sales Reps, Lab Technicians, HR, Research Scientists.

panels.title: 2. Make the first year stick
lines: 34.9% of 0-1 year employees left (55.1% with overtime). New joiners get no extra training.
Action: 90-day onboarding, mentor per new hire, front-loaded learning path, no routine overtime in year 1.

panels.title: 3. Retention plan for Sales Representatives
lines: 39.8% attrition (+23.6 pts); 91.6% are level 1, avg income 2,626 vs 6,503.
Action: pay and incentive benchmark, career path to Sales Executive, coaching.

panels.title: 4. Act on engagement signals
lines: Low job satisfaction: 22.8% attrition; bad work-life balance: 31.3%.
Action: quarterly pulse survey, manager follow-up within 30 days, flexible work options.

footnote: Associations in a fictional snapshot (IBM sample), not proven causes - test actions with a pilot first. Also improve learning data: course type, hours, completion, dates. Full analysis: 04_Docs/Insights_and_Recommendations.md
